## Feature Request — GitHub Issue Creation on Every Observation

Currently when Emily writes an observation to var/emily-observations/latest.json, it is picked up by Claude Code via the observation-watcher. There is no external ticket trail.

### Requested Behavior
Whenever fatbaby_write_observation is called (i.e. whenever latest.json is written), the pipeline should also create a GitHub issue via the GitHub API so that every finding has a permanent, linkable ticket.

### Issue content mapping
Map the observation fields to the GitHub issue as follows:
- **Title** → observation `summary` field
- **Body** → observation `findings` field, followed by a "Suggested Fix" section from `suggested_fix` if present
- **Labels** → derive from `severity`: info→"enhancement", warn→"bug", error→"critical
